## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the `evidence-package/1` typed member/role profile
   inside `hh-bundle/1` (Packet C C.1 items 1–2 and 5 — versioned
   profile record, immutable attempt/grade-attempt/export identities
   with create-if-absent semantics, `native_heads`/`watermarks` typed
   coordinates, unknown-version refusal; C.9 checks 2–3 legs owned by
   this ticket). Owned by the bundle codec/validator; a derived index,
   never a second authoritative store.
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.21.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged (R5.14 grade_pending /
   execution_settled / selection_revision classes; R5.15 population
   contract; R5.4 admission dossier). A new shared/persisted decision
   belongs in the owning ADR admission, not an implementation-local
   substitute.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): admitted versioned profile inside native
    bundle; create-if-absent attempts/grades/exports; typed
    head/watermark coordinates; same-day retries retain unique
    evidence; later append cannot mutate old snapshot.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): same ID different bytes, wrong head/last
    exported event, omitted required empty metadata, grade retry
    adding n or build-note replacing WAL refuses. Legacy
    bytes/fields/levels remain valid; unknown mandatory profile
    refuses new claim.
- [ ] AC-3 (E; ownership and evidence): every primary target resolved
    to numbered checks + actual evidence in the coverage register;
    achieved D/E recorded separately from owed R/P legs (R5.22–26,
    R5.52 named owners).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression;
    fmt + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode per touch;
    scratch stores; exact commands + counts.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in declared scope;
    REQ ids stamped; DEFERRALS rows for owed legs; ADRs for owned
    decisions; run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; operating clauses.

## Plan

- New module `crates/hh-bundle/src/profile.rs`: `evidence-package/1`
  record — `EvidenceProfile` + typed coordinate records
  (`Coord`, `NativeHead`, `Watermark`, `AttemptRef`,
  `GradeAttemptRef`, `ExportRef`), Json-validated required groups
  (`source_versions`, `claims`, `protocol_ref`, `phase`, `slot_set`,
  `pins`, `access`, `legacy_refs`), canonical to_json/from_json
  (strict required-present members incl. empty lists; unknown members
  tolerated — additive decode), `check()` producing closed-code
  violations, `ProfileIndex` create-if-absent, `peek_version` for
  legacy inspection.
- `error.rs`: `ProfileRefused { code: &'static str, detail: String }`
  — typed refusal carrying profile.rs's closed code set.
- `manifest.rs`: additive `evidence_profile: Json` section (emitted
  only when non-null — pre-R5.21 manifests decode byte-identically).
- `levels.rs`: `roles::EVIDENCE_PROFILE` + profile section joins
  `section_member_refs` (S3 member-resolution closure).
- `assemble.rs`: `AssembleInputs.evidence_profile: Option<EvidenceProfile>`
  — check() + declared-coordinate agreement against the derived
  subject head/watermark/lineage, deposit as `evidence_profile`
  member, stamp the manifest section. Derived coordinates are
  assembly-verified, never caller-asserted.
- `validate.rs`: S2 profile block — when `evidence_profile.member`
  resolves to bytes: decode (unknown version → fail
  `unknown_profile_version`; malformed → `missing_required_member`),
  `check()` violations → fail rows, agreement vs `subject.heads` /
  `subject.watermarks` / `traces[run].head`. Legacy manifests
  (no profile member) validate unchanged.
- Callsite updates: `hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs` +
  `hh-embed/tests/r4_15d{,_live}.rs` pass `evidence_profile: None`
  (kernel op doesn't mint profiles yet — producer input, later
  owner wiring per decomposition row 31).
- `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_21.rs`: AC-1/AC-2 battery.
- ADR (implementation landing record), coverage dated contributing
  note, BL-47 append (revisit-trigger index), DEFERRALS row for the
  owed legs if any new owed item arises (full-target predicates stay
  owed to R5.22–26/R5.52 per AC-3 — named already; no new deferral
  expected beyond recording).

## Cap trigger — STOPPED for a scoped ruling (CAP DISCIPLINE)

The complete AC-1+AC-2 implementation measures **1,830 changed
source/test lines** vs the contract's **≤750 split trigger**
(~2.4×):

| file | lines |
|---|---|
| `crates/hh-bundle/src/profile.rs` (new) | +858 |
| `crates/hh-bundle/tests/r5_21.rs` (new) | +689 |
| `crates/hh-bundle/src/validate.rs` | +194 |
| `crates/hh-bundle/src/assemble.rs` | +96 |
| `crates/hh-bundle/src/error.rs` / `manifest.rs` / `levels.rs` / `lib.rs` / `import.rs` / `scoped.rs` | +37 |
| `crates/hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs` + 11 test-literal callsites | +21 |

(`git diff --cached --numstat -- '*.rs'` at checkpoint `bbfd467c`,
code+test only — docs/records excluded.)

The weight is the admitted record, not padding: Packet C C.3's
R-group is required-present field by field (version, source_versions,
claims, protocol_ref, phase, slot_set, attempts, grade_attempts,
exports, native_heads, watermarks, pins, access) and the typed
coordinate records carry the identity/refusal semantics the ACs
test — create-if-absent mint, the closed violation set, strict
required-member decode, and both refusal surfaces (assembly-side
`ProfileRefused` + recipient-side S2 check rows). No AC was dropped.

**Seam analysis.** The only candidate cut is (a) the record/codec/
index + unit checks vs (b) the bundle-member integration
(`evidence_profile` manifest field + assemble deposit + S2
validation + acceptance battery) — mirroring the R5.14/R5.15
contract-owner/consumer-wiring precedent. Two objections: (i)
AC-1's single predicate — "admitted versioned profile **inside
native bundle**" — spans both halves: leg (a) alone lands a library
type whose membership in `hh-bundle/1` is unproven (no member, no
section, no validate path — the positive AC cannot execute); leg
(b) alone has no record to integrate (the negative AC's
`conflicting_identity`/`missing_required_member`/`grade_retry_
adds_n`/`build_note_as_wal` legs live in the record). (ii) Even
the record-only leg measures ~950 lines — **over the trigger
itself**; a both-legs-under split needs a three-way cut that
fragments one admitted codec/member unit. Packet C names ONE owner
for this slice — the hh-bundle codec/validator (C.2 owner map); no
documented consumer seam exists inside it. Same objection shape the
R5.19/R5.20 scoped reviews found.

**Magnitude:** ~2.4× is inside the accepted band (≤2.6× R5.8;
~1.9–2.4× routinely amended incl. R5.19 at ~1.93× and R5.20 at
~2.3×).

**Proposed disposition:** AMEND — land the record + member
integration as one unit; the implementation is complete, green
(hh-bundle 86/0 fail incl. r5_21 9/9; hh-embed r4_15d 7/0; fmt,
clippy, check-drift clean; fails-without compile-red at base
`d9e2dce9`), and already checkpointed at `bbfd467c` on
`codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.21` for review. If SPLIT is
preferred, the reviewed seam above ((a) record/index/check →
(b) manifest+assemble+validate integration) is the documented cut
— leg (a) remains over-trigger alone.
